lead: Michael Phelps is a widely followed American swimmer, born on 30 June 1985 in Baltimore.
As of 2026, he is 41 years old, and his birth date places him under the Cancer sign.
He has represented North Baltimore Aquatic Club and has been recognised with Associated Press Athlete of the Year and Associated Press Athlete of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Michael Phelps: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Michael Phelps — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Michael Phelps was born on 30 June 1985 in Baltimore, and holds American nationality. He was given the name Michael Fred Phelps II at birth and is publicly known as Michael Phelps.
Public records name his father, Michael Fred Phelps and his mother, Deborah Sue Davisson.
His listed education includes Towson High School, Dumbarton Middle School, University of Michigan and Sheldon High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Michael Phelps — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists swimmer as his main occupation.
On the team sheet, Michael has been associated with North Baltimore Aquatic Club (from 1995).

He has taken part in swimming at the 2000 Summer Olympics – men's 200 metre butterfly, swimming at the 2004 Summer Olympics – men's 100 metre butterfly, swimming at the 2004 Summer Olympics – men's 200 metre butterfly, swimming at the 2004 Summer Olympics – men's 200 metre individual medley and swimming at the 2004 Summer Olympics – men's 400 metre individual medley.
